content: Standard forecasting benchmark datasets: M1 (1001 series, yearly/quarterly/monthly) and M3 (3003 series, same frequencies) available via R Mcomp package (GPL-3, CRAN). M4 (100000 series, yearly/quarterly/monthly/weekly/daily/hourly) from Mcompetitions/M4-methods GitHub (MIT-compatible, also on Kaggle as CC-BY). M5 (42840 hierarchical Walmart retail series, daily) — Kaggle competition rules restrict to competition use only; a Zenodo copy exists (CC-BY 4.0). Tourism (1311 series, yearly/quarterly/monthly, Athanasopoulos & Hyndman) via Tcomp R package or Hyndman's website. NN5 (111 daily ATM cash withdrawal series, UK, 735 obs) on Zenodo CC-BY 4.0. Monash Time Series Forecasting Archive at forecastingdata.org: 30 datasets / 58 variants, CC-BY 4.0 for research, includes M1/M3/M4/Tourism/NN5/KDD2018 and energy, transport, weather domains. HuggingFace mirror: Monash-University/monash_tsf. Use .tsf format with R/Python wrappers provided. For vendoring in a Rust project, M3 (smallest useful corpus, GPL-3 data), M4 monthly subset, and NN5 (CC-BY) are safest to include. M5 requires Kaggle account acceptance.
